offering_description.value: Operates online auctions for salvage and used vehicles, connecting insurers and other vehicle sellers with dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers and individual buyers. Also provides vehicle collection, storage and sale processing.

primary_products.value: Used and salvage vehicles purchased for resale

primary_services.value: Online vehicle auctions; vehicle remarketing; vehicle collection and transport; vehicle storage; title and sale document processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Insurers, vehicle dealers, fleet operators, rental companies, vehicle dismantlers, recyclers and rebuilders; B2C: Individuals selling vehicles and eligible consumers buying auction vehicles

end_markets.value: Automotive insurance; used vehicles; automotive repair and rebuilding; vehicle dismantling and recycling; fleet disposal

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Buyers and sellers pay fees associated with vehicle auction transactions; service fees: Charges for vehicle transport, storage, title processing and related services; subscription: Buyers pay membership fees for auction participation and bidding privileges; product sales: Sells vehicles purchased for its own account
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; subscription; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes and remarkets vehicles from insurers and other sellers to automotive trade buyers and consumers; software / platform: Operates an online marketplace connecting vehicle sellers with registered bidders; asset operator: Operates physical vehicle yards for receiving, storing and releasing auction vehicles; retailer: Purchases some used and salvage vehicles for resale to vehicle buyers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator; retailer

geography_served.value: global: Operations across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Brazil, with an international buyer base

company_size.value: Large international vehicle auction operator with an extensive yard network and a global online buyer base

specialization.value: related lines: Vehicle auctions and remarketing, supported by vehicle transport, storage, document processing and direct vehicle purchasing

distribution_channels.value: online: Proprietary auction website and mobile applications; direct sales: Direct relationships with insurers, fleets, dealers and other vehicle sellers; own locations: Vehicle yards provide inspection access and vehicle collection; agents / brokers: Registered brokers help buyers access auctions subject to licensing restrictions
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Vehicle auction, dealer and salvage activities require jurisdiction-specific licenses, motor vehicle authorities oversee titles and sales, while environmental agencies regulate vehicle storage and handling

notes: No website page text was provided; the description relies on model knowledge.
